The same open-plan Manhattan office as in the reference image, present day: white desks running back in rows towards tall windows full of grey city towers. In the foreground, a man in his thirties with short dark hair and a plain grey sweater sits rigidly at his desk, eyes fixed on his blank monitor, shoulders hunched up towards his ears. The woman from the character reference stands right behind his chair, leaning over his shoulder, her index finger raised and wagging at his screen, brows pulled down hard, lips pressed into a thin line mid-sentence. She is a third in from the left of the frame. Ordinary overcast daylight from the windows. Medium shot at desk height from the side, the colleague sharp, the office falling soft behind them. Monitors show only soft blank light.

Thanks.
